title: Re-evaluating after changes

D0.outcome: Explains that an evaluation must be updated after exchanges, pawn breaks and tactics, and that the old plan may no longer fit.

D1.outcome: After a stated change in a position, restates which imbalance changed and what plan now fits.

D2.outcome: In unlabeled sequences, spots the move that changes the evaluation and re-picks the plan instead of continuing the old one.

D3.outcome: Notices when a habit-driven plan is continuing after the position changed, and does a fresh valuation as a spectator would.

misconceptions: A plan chosen at move 12 stays valid at move 30.
conditions: A concrete change (exchange, break, tactic) has altered the imbalances.
contrasts: Sticking to the old plan after a pawn break changed the structure (thinking inertia).
Changing plans constantly without a changed position.
A position unchanged since the last evaluation.
